# Lumyo

> Lumyo is a Portuguese digital studio specialising in premium website development, process automation, artificial intelligence solutions and digital growth strategies for businesses.

Official website: [Lumyo](https://www.lumyo.pt)
Primary market: Portugal
Languages: Portuguese (pt-PT) and English

## About Lumyo

Lumyo designs and develops digital systems for businesses.

Its work combines strategy, design, software development, automation, artificial intelligence and digital growth.

The studio focuses on four main areas:

- Premium Websites
- Business Automation
- Artificial Intelligence Solutions
- Digital Growth

## Premium Websites

[Premium Websites](https://www.lumyo.pt/solutions/websites)

Lumyo develops bespoke websites and digital platforms designed around the identity, goals and operational requirements of each business.

Capabilities include:

- Bespoke corporate websites
- Landing pages
- E-commerce
- Custom Shopify experiences
- Web applications
- Administration areas
- Databases
- API and third-party integrations
- Technical SEO
- Structured data
- Performance optimisation
- Analytics and tracking

Websites can integrate with CRM systems, payments, automation platforms and other business software.

## Business Automation

[Business Automation](https://www.lumyo.pt/solutions/automation)

Lumyo develops automation systems designed to reduce repetitive manual work and connect business processes and software.

Capabilities include:

- Lead capture
- Lead qualification
- CRM automation
- Appointment automation
- Automated follow-ups
- Notifications
- Data synchronisation
- System integrations
- Workflow automation

Automation is used for predictable and repetitive processes while keeping human intervention where decisions or customer relationships require it.

## Artificial Intelligence

[Artificial Intelligence](https://www.lumyo.pt/solutions/ai)

Lumyo integrates artificial intelligence into business processes and digital products.

Capabilities include:

- AI assistants
- Intelligent chatbots
- AI-powered automation
- Information search and analysis
- Document processing
- Data extraction
- Classification
- AI integration with CRM systems, databases, websites and internal software

AI is used where processes require language understanding, information interpretation, classification, summarisation or other tasks that cannot be handled effectively through fixed rules alone.

## Digital Growth

[Digital Growth](https://www.lumyo.pt/solutions/growth)

Lumyo develops data-driven digital growth strategies designed to increase visibility, qualified traffic, leads and business opportunities.

Capabilities include:

- SEO
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Google Ads
- Meta Ads
- Social media management
- Landing pages
- Analytics
- Tracking
- Google Business Profile optimisation
- Conversion analysis

SEO focuses on visibility in traditional search engines.

GEO focuses on making brand and business information clear, structured and useful for AI-powered search and answer experiences.

SEO and GEO are complementary disciplines.

## Selected Work

[Case Studies](https://www.lumyo.pt/case-studies)

Lumyo presents examples of digital systems and strategies applied to real business problems.

### Auto Silcar

Area: Premium Websites

Auto Silcar is an automotive digital platform with a database and administration area that allows vehicles to be added and removed without manually modifying the website.

The system includes lead capture forms, email notifications through Resend and centralised contact records in the administration area.

Capabilities include:

- Vehicle management
- Administration area
- Database
- Lead capture
- Forms
- Email notifications
- Lead management

### Clinic Conversion and Automation System

Area: Automation and Artificial Intelligence

A qualification, conversion and retention system designed for an aesthetics clinic.

The system connects lead capture, qualification, appointments and follow-ups.

A 24/7 assistant can operate across the website, WhatsApp and Instagram to:

- Explain services and initial pricing
- Provide information about professionals and specialties
- Show available appointment times
- Book, reschedule and cancel appointments
- Provide location and instructions
- Answer frequently asked questions
- Transfer the conversation to a human when required

The objective is not simply to generate more contacts, but to identify people with genuine intent and move them efficiently towards an appointment.

### Olá

Area: SaaS, Fitness and Nutrition

Olá is a digital platform for personal trainers, nutritionists, gyms and studios.

It centralises professional client management, training, nutrition, communication and progress tracking.

Capabilities include:

- Workout Builder
- Nutrition Builder
- Client management
- Check-ins
- Chat
- Progress tracking
- Automation

### Digital Growth

Area: Digital Growth

Lumyo has experience developing digital growth strategies using analysis of business presence, social media, advertising channels and performance data.

Work can combine:

- Social media management
- Meta Ads
- Google Ads
- SEO
- GEO
- Analytics
- Google Business Profile
- Performance analysis
